verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way for telli's voice agents to connect to external MCP servers as tool sources. The documented MCP server is the opposite role: it lets outside AI tools like Claude talk to Charlie. Custom tools that call your own APIs are a related but different feature, so neither earns credit for MCP-client toolsets mid-call.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my voice agent can plug in MCP servers as tool sources so one integration grants it whole toolsets mid-call
